How we work

A simple, proven four-step process.

01

Discover

A deep audit of your brand, channels, seasonality and unit economics. No assumptions, no generic playbooks.

02

Strategise

A bespoke plan: channel mix, budget split, creative direction and clear KPIs. You see the thinking before we spend a pound.

03

Execute

04

Optimise

Continuous testing and honest monthly reporting on the numbers that matter: enquiries, bookings and cost per booking.

FAQ

Questions, answered.

Who do you work with?

The whole travel industry. Consumer-facing brands — tour operators, travel agencies, OTAs, hotels and resorts, airlines — and the B2B side too: travel tech, voice AI and SaaS companies selling to agents, suppliers and the trade. If your buyer is in travel, we speak their language.

What do the humans do, and what does the AI do?

People do the thinking and the making: strategy, ideas, design, copy and campaign decisions all come from our travel marketing experts. AI handles the heavy lifting underneath — research, audience analysis, reporting and admin — which makes us faster and keeps more of your budget in media and creative.

What does the free ad account audit include?

We review your Meta, Google or other ad accounts: account structure, conversion tracking, audience and budget efficiency, and creative performance. You get a plain-English summary of what's wasting money and what to fix first — with no obligation to work with us afterwards.

How do contracts work?

Monthly rolling contracts. We earn the next month by delivering in this one — there are no long lock-ins.

How quickly can we start?

Typically within two weeks of signing. The first days go on discovery and account setup, then we move straight into building and launching.

How do you report results?

Monthly reporting built around the metrics that matter to a travel business — enquiries, bookings and cost per booking — not vanity numbers. You'll always know what's working, what isn't, and what we're changing.

We're not a travel brand — can you still help?

Travel is our specialism and where we do our best work. We occasionally take on brands in adjacent spaces where our approach clearly fits — get in touch and we'll tell you honestly either way.
